documents.title: Enterprise Security and Access Policy
documents.content: All persistent database files must be encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM. Android Keystore keys must be generated inside the hardware-backed Secure Element or StrongBox when available. Biometric authentication is required for financial exports. Remote data transmission must enforce TLS 1.3.

documents.title: Employee Leave and Absence Guidelines
documents.content: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Sick leave is granted up to 10 days without a medical certificate. Maternity leave is 26 weeks fully paid. Paternity leave is 2 weeks.

documents.title: Corporate Travel Reimbursement Standard
documents.content: Daily meal allowances are capped at $75 per day within North America and 80 EUR within the European Union. Receipts are mandatory for all expenses exceeding $25. Flight bookings longer than 6 hours are eligible for Premium Economy.

cases.question: What encryption standard is required for persistent database files?
cases.expectedAnswer: Persistent database files must be encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM.

cases.question: How many weeks of paid maternity leave are provided to employees?
cases.expectedAnswer: Maternity leave is 26 weeks fully paid.
